metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer School Spirit | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer school spirit apparel with no minimums. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on decorated gear.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration produces vibrant, full-color designs on polyester and poly-cotton blend apparel, making it a popular choice for school spirit uniforms, fan gear, and event shirts. Unlike screen printing, heat transfers allow for photographic detail and gradient colors without setup fees for each color. This method works especially well for customizing spirit jerseys, hoodies, and tees with mascots, logos, or player names. Order in bulk for your school store, athletic teams, or spirit days and get consistent, durable results that withstand repeated washing.
